prompt: What is population in 1968 of the city that hosted the olympic games in which Lucy Steele competed?
answer: Lucy Steele competed at the **1968 Summer Olympics in Mexico City**. Mexico City’s population was approximately **6.87 million (6,874,100)** in 1968. (Metropolitan-area estimates were higher, around 8 million.)
